basic_sanctum.name: Basic Sanctum
basic_sanctum.desc: The first circle of protection around the Ember. The ash feels a little farther away.

haven.name: Haven
haven.unlock_log: With enough shards, you could raise a proper Haven. The lost might stay.
haven.desc: A place for the lost to rest near the Ember. They offer their hands in return. They stay. The circle begins here.

foraging_lines.name: Foraging Lines
foraging_lines.unlock_log: The ash around the ember offers paths... and things that walk them.
foraging_lines.desc: Marked paths into the ash. Those who walk them return with more than fuel.

watch_spire.name: Watch Spire
watch_spire.unlock_log: A vein claimed. The ash now has watchers. The Watch Spire stands ready.
watch_spire.desc: Eyes on the veins. It watches the ash as much as the ash watches it.

labor_hall.name: Labor Hall
labor_hall.unlock_log: The circle needs hands that stay. The Hall will gather them.
labor_hall.desc: A place to train and house the lost as steady labor. Their work strengthens the veins and the watch.

spire_works.name: Spire Works
spire_works.unlock_log: The Watch needs more eyes. The Works will raise them faster.
spire_works.desc: Foundry and shaping for additional Watch Spires and basic defenses. Speeds construction along the claimed veins.

dread_foundry.name: Dread Foundry
dread_foundry.unlock_log: The ash hardens under a firm will. The Foundry forges tools that bite back.
dread_foundry.desc: Tyrant-leaning production for spiked watchers and aggressive defenses. High output, but the veins remember the cost.

sanctuary_ward.name: Sanctuary Ward
sanctuary_ward.unlock_log: The circle can shelter as well as claim. The Ward remembers those who answer willingly.
sanctuary_ward.desc: Benevolent-leaning warding structures. Reduces losses on the veins and offers steadier returns for those who walk them.

vein_forge.name: Vein Forge
vein_forge.unlock_log: The veins themselves can be worked. The Forge shapes what the ash yields.
vein_forge.desc: A simple forge along claimed lines. Produces steady labor for defense and the walks (neutral production option).

spire_foundry.name: Spire Foundry
spire_foundry.unlock_log: More spires, faster. The will to watch shapes the ash harder.
spire_foundry.desc: Aggressive spire production. Faster build speed for all queues, with a bite of defense (tyrant-leaning spire option).

resonance_spire.name: Resonance Spire
resonance_spire.unlock_log: The circle can listen as well as command. The Spire will call voices back.
resonance_spire.desc: A spire tuned to the pulse. Those who walk the veins return with more than they left, and the ash feels less empty.

will_press.name: Will Press
will_press.unlock_log: Press the ash harder. The veins yield when will is firm.
will_press.desc: A press that draws more from the claimed ground and those who work it. High gain, the cost paid in silence.

vein_ward.name: Vein Ward
vein_ward.unlock_log: The veins can be held gently as well as gripped.
vein_ward.desc: Wards along the lines that remember those who walk them. Steady defense without the bite.

echo_choir.name: Echo Choir
echo_choir.unlock_log: Voices gather where you first opened the havens. The Echo Choir answers the circle's listening.
echo_choir.desc: A choir of returned echoes. Softens raids along the veins and deepens what walkers bring back — only for circles that sheltered and listened.

ash_binder.name: Ash Binder
ash_binder.unlock_log: The ash binds to the will you first demanded. The Binder closes what the circle opens only to take.
ash_binder.desc: Binds claimed ash into yielding ground. High shard return and retaliatory bite — only for circles that demanded and harvested.
